_comment: Curation of the OS Characteristic-Sheet face inventory into distinct TYPEFACES, from eyeballing admin_probe/glyph_ui.html. The CS names categories, not faces: several are one typeface at a different size, and size is normalised out of these glyphs. Every operation is declared against the ORIGINAL labels/alphabet_glyphs.npz and applied from scratch, so the spec stays reproducible however many rounds it accumulates. Face names follow the signature convention Style-Fill-Decor.

drop.antiq_norman: no decent samples — cleared, awaiting repopulation

_replace_notes: antiq_roman's own samples are unusable, but the railways_passenger set is the SAME typeface and is clean, so it becomes the sample set for that face and railways_passenger is retired as a separate name.

delete_glyph_ids.84: second P of Upright-Solid-Serif (woods_copses, word 11, 8.4 deg)

_notes.Italic-Solid-Serif: cleared: its samples mixed two weights, now split into Italic-Solid-Serif and Italic-Solid-Serif-Light

_inventory: The full face inventory, including permutations not yet spotted, lives in labels/face_inventory.json. Provenance back to OS category keys is NOT maintained: once a face is named by its signature, new samples are labelled with that name directly.
